title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Fordham University
description: Ten under-21-safe food stops around Fordham’s Rose Hill campus with late service documented by current university-adjacent business pages. Confirm hours before leaving because schedules can change.

cards.title: Pizza Until 3 A.M.
cards.subtitle: 590 East 191st Street, beside Fordham’s Rose Hill campus
cards.notes: Walk east toward the 191st Street storefront, confirm the posted closing time, and order at the counter for dine-in or takeaway.
cards.short_summary: A campus-edge pizzeria with the board’s latest documented closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Pugsley Pizza’s official site lists 590 East 191st Street and opening hours until 3 a.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists Monday–Saturday 11 a.m.–3 a.m. and Sunday 2 p.m.–3 a.m.; verify same-night hours before going.

cards.title: An After-Midnight Fordham Road Counter
cards.subtitle: 342 East Fordham Road, south of the Rose Hill campus
cards.notes: Head to the East Fordham Road storefront when other counters have closed, then check the locator before choosing dine-in or takeaway.
cards.short_summary: A chain counter with official hours extending deep into the night every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official location page lists restaurant service until 2:30 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:59 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 342 E Fordham Rd in Bronx, NY
cards.access_notes: Official hours run to 2:30 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:59 a.m. Friday–Saturday; recheck the locator before departure.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell at 8 West Fordham Road
cards.title: Tacos Across the Concourse
cards.subtitle: 8 West Fordham Road, west of the Grand Concourse
cards.notes: Use the Fordham Road corridor to reach this counter, and review the official page before making the longer trip from Rose Hill.
cards.short_summary: A West Fordham Road destination whose dine-in schedule reaches 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page identifies 8 West Fordham Road and lists dine-in service from 9 a.m. to 2 a.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurant at 8 W Fordham Rd
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists dine-in hours of 9 a.m.–2 a.m.; check the full daily schedule before traveling west.

cards.title: Weekend Breakfast at Any Hour
cards.subtitle: 410 East 189th Street, near Fordham Plaza
cards.notes: Choose this sit-down option for a late meal, but check the day carefully because round-the-clock service begins on Friday.
cards.short_summary: A nearby family restaurant operating overnight on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official restaurant page lists midnight closing Monday–Thursday and 24-hour operation Friday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 7 a.m.–midnight Monday–Thursday and 24 hours Friday–Sunday; verify holiday exceptions.

cards.title: Arthur Avenue After Midnight
cards.subtitle: 2376 Arthur Avenue in Bronx Little Italy
cards.notes: Make this a seated Arthur Avenue stop, and allow enough time to order before the restaurant’s documented 12:30 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: An Italian dining room with the same after-midnight closing time all week.
cards.evidence_claim: Frankies Restaurant’s official site lists its address as 2376 Arthur Avenue and hours of 11 a.m.–12:30 a.m. Monday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists daily hours of 11 a.m.–12:30 a.m.; call ahead if arriving close to the kitchen’s closing time.

cards.title: Coffee on Arthur Avenue Until 11
cards.subtitle: 2307 Arthur Avenue, south of East 187th Street
cards.notes: Use the cafe’s downstairs space only while it remains available, and confirm the 11 p.m. schedule before settling in late.
cards.short_summary: A cafe-format stop with an official daily closing time of 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Noya Cafe’s official site lists 2307 Arthur Avenue and working hours of 7 a.m.–11 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: The business lists 7 a.m.–11 p.m. every day; verify the current schedule before planning a late study or food stop.

cards.title: A Late Crescent Avenue Dinner
cards.subtitle: 603 Crescent Avenue, east of Arthur Avenue
cards.notes: Reserve or call before heading to this seated restaurant, especially for its later Friday and Saturday service windows.
cards.short_summary: A Crescent Avenue dining room with documented 11 p.m. weekend closings.
cards.evidence_claim: Roberto’s official site lists dinner until 10 p.m. Tuesday–Thursday and until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours reach 10 p.m. Tuesday–Thursday and 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday; the site lists Monday and Sunday closed.

cards.title: A One A.M. Weekend Table
cards.subtitle: 2389 Arthur Avenue in Bronx Little Italy
cards.notes: Plan this as a Friday or Saturday dinner run, and contact the restaurant before relying on its published 1 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: An Arthur Avenue restaurant with late weekend service documented on its own site.
cards.evidence_claim: Moise’s official site lists service until 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours are 11:30 a.m.–10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11:30 a.m.–1 a.m. Friday–Saturday; confirm before going.

cards.title: A 24-Hour Drive-Thru Option
cards.subtitle: 2505 Southern Boulevard, east of the Rose Hill campus
cards.notes: Check whether your group needs lobby or drive-thru access, because the official page documents different overnight schedules.
cards.short_summary: A nearby chain location with round-the-clock drive-thru hours and later weekend lobby service.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official page lists a 24-hour drive-thru daily; lobby hours reach midnight Friday–Saturday and 11 p.m. otherwise.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru hours are listed as 24 hours daily; lobby closes at 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: A Bedford Park Boulevard Slice Stop
cards.subtitle: 397 Bedford Park Boulevard, north of Rose Hill
cards.notes: Take the northbound route to Bedford Park Boulevard and place the order before the published 10 p.m. closing time.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood pizzeria north of campus with late-evening pickup and delivery.
cards.evidence_claim: Rocco’s Pizzeria’s direct ordering site identifies 397 Bedford Park Boulevard and lists hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant’s direct ordering page lists 11 a.m.–10 p.m.; recheck the full-hours control before a late pickup.

warnings: Hours can change for holidays, academic breaks, weather, or operating conditions; verify each direct source on the day of travel.
Some destinations require a longer walk or transit trip from Rose Hill; use a well-lit route and travel with companions late at night.
The McDonald's drive-thru may not accommodate pedestrians overnight; confirm the available service mode before departure.
